title: 16S Illumina Primer Plate Resuspension (100 µM)
author: Rodolfo A Salido Benitez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ukgeutw
materials: ep.T.I.P.S. Motion Racks 20 - 300 µL w/ filter

steps.title: Add water to reservoir
steps.instruction: In a sterile 30 mL reservoir, add exactly 11.725 mL of PCR Clean Water (minimum required volume) to be used for resuspending the four 96‑well primer plates.

steps.title: Set up epMotion worktable
steps.instruction: Arrange the epMotion 5075 liquid‑handling deck as follows:

substeps.instruction: Place four boxes of ep.T.I.P.S. Motion Racks (20‑300 µL with filter) in slots A2, A3, A4, and A5.
Place the four 96‑well plates containing lyophilized primers from IDT in slots B2, B3, B4, and B5.
Place the 30 mL reservoir containing the PCR Clean Water in slot 1 of the Reservoir Rack, then position the rack in slot C5.

steps.title: Run automated resuspension protocol
steps.instruction: Import the protocol file Application_4_Resus_100uM_Primers_181003_105824.export6 into epBlue software (version 40.6 or later), remove box lids and plate foils, then execute the protocol which transfers 30 µL of PCR Clean Water into each well of the four 96‑well primer plates and mixes by pipetting for 5 cycles to achieve a 100 µM primer solution (3 nmol primer per well).

steps.title: Centrifuge primer plates
steps.instruction: Centrifuge all four 96‑well primer plates briefly to ensure the lyophilized sample is settled at the bottom of each well.

steps.title: Seal plates for storage
steps.instruction: Remove the plates from the worktable and seal each with storage aluminum foil.
